name: pigpen-pi-typesafe
description: Go port of pi-typesafe's extension: the batched typesafe_evaluate tool, the /typesafe command (login, consent, usage, sample test, playground) and result renderers. Off until the operator enables it. Content goes to api.typesafe.ai unless the own-model backend (the model PiG is configured with) is selected.
author: Michael Kinsy
